title: Federated learning system of calibrating the heterogeneity of clients with non-IID data

pse.problem: Non-IID (Independently and Identically Distributed) data among clients in Federated Learning causes reduced convergence speed and performance of the global model
pse.solution_function: The system performs bias adjustment on a classifier during local learning by applying a bias adjustment coefficient to alleviate distortion and measure the accuracy of a label, and central server updates the classifier based on the accuracy of labels from each client to correct heterogeneity among clients
pse.solution_structure: Key components include local models at distributed clients, classifiers (FedRS), central server
pse.solution_implementation: Local clients train local models and transmit model parameters to the central server. The central server aggregates the parameters, updates a global model, and adjusts the classifier based on the accuracy of labels from each client. FedRS uses a Restricted Softmax method to limit weight updates based on presence or absence of labels during local learning
pse.effect: Improved convergence speed and performance of the global model in Non-IID data environments
